# Flash sale text message

## Description

Builds the list of recently active shoppers, drafts a time-limited offer text without inventing a discount or deadline it does not have, and drafts a reach note for marketing ops to review before anything sends.

## Steps

### Step 1: Build the flash-sale audience

Build a new segment named "Flash Sale Audience". A user is in the segment only when they triggered page view event at least 3 times in the last 7 d.

### Step 2: Write the flash sale SMS

Generate an SMS for the users in the segment from "Build the flash-sale audience" announcing a limited-time the discount percentage for this run% discount on their next purchase, ending the offer end date for this run. End with the offer's landing-page URL chosen for this run, written as a plain link. Write one or two sentences in a direct and urgent tone. Use the result of "Build the flash-sale audience". This drafts the SMS only; a person still sends it.

### Step 3: Draft a note for marketing ops

Generate a Slack message to the marketing ops channel (marketing ops channel) noting the size of the segment from "Build the flash-sale audience" so the team can track reach before the sale goes out. Use the result of "Build the flash-sale audience". This drafts the Slack message only; a person on the team still posts it. Use the segment's current member count from the step that built it; never write a placeholder in square brackets. If no count is available, name the segment and say it can be opened in Segments.
